english: I'm the doctor, I'm going to check your eyes.
target: 我是医生，我来检查您的眼睛。
romanisation: Wǒ shì yīshēng, wǒ lái jiǎnchá nín de yǎnjīng.

english: Does it hurt? Point to where.
romanisation: Tòng ma? Nǎlǐ tòng? Qǐng zhǐ yíxià.

english: Please read the smallest line you can see.
target: 请念您能看到的最小的一行。
romanisation: Qǐng niàn nín néng kàndào de zuì xiǎo de yì háng.

english: Tell me if you see the light move.
romanisation: Kàndào guāng yídòng qǐng gàosu wǒ.

english: Do you see two of me?
romanisation: Nín kàndào liǎng ge wǒ ma?

english: Is it worse looking this way?
romanisation: Kàn zhège fāngxiàng gèng yánzhòng ma?

english: Look at my finger. Don't move your head.
target: 请看我的手指，头不要动。
romanisation: Qǐng kàn wǒ de shǒuzhǐ, tóu búyào dòng.

english: Are you allergic to any medications?
I'm going to put drops in your eye.
romanisation: Wǒ yào gěi nín diǎn yǎnyàoshuǐ.

english: This is an analgesic for your eyes. It may sting for a few seconds.
target: 这是眼睛的麻药，可能会刺痛几秒钟。
romanisation: Zhè shì yǎnjīng de máyào, kěnéng huì cìtòng jǐ miǎozhōng.

english: This drop will dilate your pupils.
Your vision will be blurry for about 6 hours.
target: 您的视力会模糊大约六个小时。
romanisation: Nín de shìlì huì móhu dàyuē liù ge xiǎoshí.

english: The light is bright. Please bear with it.
romanisation: Dēng huì hěn liàng, qǐng rěn yíxià.

english: I'm going to touch your eyelid.
romanisation: Wǒ yào pèng yíxià nín de yǎnpí.

english: The exam is finished. Thank you.
We will use an interpreter to explain the results.
target: 我们会用翻译跟您解释检查结果。
romanisation: Wǒmen huì yòng fānyì gēn nín jiěshì jiǎnchá jiéguǒ.
